hook.name: ClankerHookStaticFee
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for the Clanker token factory that applies asymmetric static LP fees (separate rates for buying vs. selling the clanker token), collects a protocol fee (20% of LP fee) on each swap via BeforeSwapDelta/AfterSwapDelta adjustments, and includes a time-limited MEV protection module active for the first 2 minutes of a pool's life.
